title: aoxbt
tagline: Agent swarm orchestration that hunts for alphas, filters them with agents of diverse expertise, and executes trades with a dedicated portfolio management agent.
description:
Agent swarm orchestration that hunts for alphas, filters them with agents of diverse expertise, and executes trades with a dedicated portfolio management agent.

- Agents Orchestration: Alpha hunter agent, Bizyugo (Sentiment agent), Murad (Memecoin Expert Agent), Portfolio Manager Agent
- Open Source: Enable people to add a pull request adding new agents
- CLI Tools: Build as an CLI tools to run 24/7
- Fee Distribution: Incentivise AI Agent development by receiving percentage of swapped ETH

Github Repositories:
- https://github.com/Nava-Labs/aoxbt-contracts
- https://github.com/Nava-Labs/aoxbt
- https://github.com/Nava-Labs/agentic-hackathon
how_its_made:
AOXBT is built as a CLI application designed to orchestrate multiple AI agents. These agents are powered by Eliza, which enables them to analyze and based on real-time socials and on-chain data. To streamline multi-wallet management, we leverage Privy to create the executor agent wallets, ensuring a seamless experience when handling multiple identities in future integrations.

For deployment, we use OpSec to host the Eliza frontend, guaranteeing high availability—living up to OpSec’s tagline, "accessible even when the apocalypse comes." The agents specialize in finding alpha in the Base and Arbitrum ecosystems, continuously scanning for opportunities.
